abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same systolic drop.
section:
### Additional comparison

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 4. Counts and means for every group, measure and subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Mean | SD | n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Systolic drop | 11.7 | 5.8 | 750 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Brostamide | Systolic drop | 11.9 | 6.0 | 750 |

Each group is reported in the same way for every measure.
